title: Polynomial time for the nested empty-head test
statement: For a bit string $s$, let $\pi_2$ be the total second projection from the self-delimiting pair parser and $\pi_1$ its total first projection. The function returning the one-bit list whose bit is true exactly when $\pi_1(\pi_2(s))$ is empty is polynomial-time computable.
